protocol.purpose: Supplementary transfer diagnostic, specified while main development fits were running, before final selection/benchmark results
protocol.train_cells: Keep only centers with maximum-coordinate distance >2 degrees from every audit center, so 5x5 patches (radius 1 degree) do not overlap spatially
protocol.models: Same seven families as main protocol; neural epochs fixed by main development, three seeds. No new tuning or effect on main selection.
protocol.limitation: Main epoch selection saw northern California in earlier development years; this is a refit transfer diagnostic, not a wholly unseen-geography model-development exercise. Known 2023-2025 benchmark is already inspected.
